THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 29.09.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 BAIL APPL. NO. 12182 OF 2025  2  2025:KER:72850  BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, J.
 -------------------------------------
 B.A.No.12182 of 2025  ------------------------------------
 Dated this the 29th day of September, 2025  ORDER
This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.869 of 2025 of Mathilakom Police Station, Thrissur, which is now transferred and pending as Crime No.1206 of 2025 of Munambam Police Station,
Ernakulam.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 63, 64(2)(m)
and 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
3.

According to the prosecution, the accused had induced the defacto complainant under a promise of marriage and forced her to indulge in sexual intercourse on 03.09.2024, 13.09.2024, 26.09.2024 and again on 18.10.2024 at different places and thereby committed the offences alleged.
Petitioner was arrested on 13.09.2025 and he has been in custody since then.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.

5. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the entire prosecution allegations are false as the victim is a married lady and suppressing the factum of the said marriage, she had even entered into a wedding engagement on 16.09.2024 with the petitioner.
According to the learned counsel, subsequently, on becoming aware about the earlier marriage, petitioner withdrew from the relationship and thereafter a false crime has been registered against him.

In support of the above contention, petitioner has produced Annexure-I which is Crime No.358 of 2024 of Valappad Police Station, Thrissur Rural wherein the defacto complainant had filed an FIR against her husband and Sreejith vs State Of Kerala on 29 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20856629/
2 his family members alleging offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and other provisions.
6.
The learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application and submitted that the allegations are serious and the petitioner ought not to be released on bail.

7. On a perusal of Annexure-1 FIR in Crime No.358 of 2024 of Valappad Police Station, it is noticed that the defacto complainant has BAIL APPL. NO. 12182 OF 2025 2025:KER:72850 made an allegation under Section 498A of IPC, alleging that she had married a person by name Sri.Navaneeth on 27.03.2023.
There is nothing to indicate that the said marriage has been dissolved.

In the present crime i.e. Crime No.869 of 2025 of Mathilakom Police Station, which is transferred to Munambam Police Station, the defacto complainant has suppressed the factum of her earlier marriage.
Taking into reckoning the aforesaid suppression of marriage in the present crime
, I am of the view that further custody of the petitioner is not necessary.

In the result, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he tamper with the evidence or contact the victim or her family members.
(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions or if any modification or deletion of the conditions are required, the jurisdictional BAIL APPL. NO. 12182 OF 2025 2025:KER:72850 Court shall be empowered to consider such applications, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS, JUDGE RKM BAIL APPL. NO. 12182 OF 2025 2025:KER:72850 APPENDIX OF BAIL APPL. 12182/2025 PETITIONER'S ANNEXURES Annexure 1 THE TRUE COPY OF THE FIR IN CRIME NO.358/2024 IS REGISTERED BY THE VALAPPAD POLICE STATION DT.14.4.2024
